name: Next Step House Buyers

hero.title: We Buy Houses in Houston
hero.lead: Sell your house as-is and pay no agent fees. No cleaning, no repairs and no showings — get a fair cash offer and close on your timeline.
hero.imageAlt: A single-story brick house with a two-car garage on an open lot

divisions.title: Sell Your House As-Is
divisions.text: We buy houses in any condition, whether the home is outdated, needs repairs or you simply want to avoid listing with an agent. In many cases we take care of unwanted items left behind.

divisions.title: Get a Fair Cash Offer
divisions.text: In many cases we can present a fair, all-cash offer in as little as 24 hours. No obligations and no fees.

divisions.title: Close On Your Timeline
divisions.text: You choose the closing day. We pay all closing costs and can often close in as little as 7 days, or later if you need more time.

divisions.title: Avoid Foreclosure
divisions.text: If your situation qualifies, we can walk you through the options for stopping a foreclosure.

divisions.title: Inherited and Probate Homes
divisions.text: Inherited an unwanted property or working through probate? We buy it exactly as it stands.

divisions.title: Vacant Houses and Rentals
divisions.text: Vacant properties and rentals with difficult tenants, bought without repairs or showings.

about.title: Run by Chris and Shanna since 2020
about.text: Next Step House Buyers is a family-owned business based out of Spring, Texas. Chris and Shanna have helped hundreds of homeowners across Houston and surrounding Texas communities sell unwanted properties without the traditional hassles of listing with an agent, and when they are not the right fit for a situation they do their best to point homeowners in the right direction.
about.imageAlt: Chris and Shanna, the founders of Next Step House Buyers

reviews.author: Rachel McCarty
reviews.text: It was great working with Chris! Besides him being very professional, he made the whole process smooth and easy.

reviews.author: Doug Struckmeyer
reviews.text: Chris handled the sale of some property I owned. Amazingly strong in his work ethic and getting things done.

reviews.author: Nikki Jefferson
reviews.text: They are easily one of the most professional cash home buyers in Houston, Texas.

strapline: Cash Offers · Any Condition · No Fees
